summary: Daktronics filed an 8-K disclosing board approval on October 12, 2026 of manufacturing-network optimization initiatives, including a phased exit of its Ennistymon, Ireland facility and termination of most Irish employees via a plan of termination, alongside exiting highly customized international transportation (rail, bus, roadway) business outside North America. Estimated cumulative cash and non-cash charges are approximately $13.5 million: $11.7 million severance/stay/termination benefits, $0.8 million exit and equipment-transfer costs, and $1.0 million PP&E impairments. Roughly $12.3 million hits fiscal 2027, remainder in first-half fiscal 2028; future cash payments near $12.5 million. Substantially complete mid-fiscal 2028; workforce reductions subject to local Irish regulatory requirements. Watch execution timing, potential site-disposition gains or FX swings altering charges.
